messages.title: F5 — FREEZE-ROUND DISTRIBUTION AND SAFETY ASSERTIONS
messages.verbatim: F5: drop the “≥99% of seeds freeze within 25 rounds” acceptance condition; it predates β_c = 12. Fixtures run to a horizon long enough to finish and report the freeze-round distribution. The hard assertions remain zero false freezes and zero split freezes. Append this to the inputs bundle, apply it, STOP.

messages.title: F1 — PREVIOUS-IN GATE VALUE
messages.verbatim: F1: the gate uses c only when the item’s previous success side is IN; otherwise its gate value is 0. The same applies when computing the mean over W. This replaces “remove the false implication only”. With it, a gate entrant after a freeze is FINAL-in. Append this to the inputs bundle, apply it, and continue the IMPCD iterations.

operations.old_text: REVIEW ROUND 4: independent technical IMPCD review applied in place; F5 remains OPEN.
operations.new_text: REVIEW ROUND 4: author resolutions of F1 and F5 applied; independent IMPCD review continues.

operations.old_text: Compute mu=sum(c[x] for x in W_before)/|W_before|, or 0 if empty.
operations.new_text: Define gate_value[x]=c[x] if the previous success side is IN, and 0 otherwise (including no previous success). Compute mu=sum(gate_value[x] for x in W_before)/|W_before|, or 0 if empty.

operations.old_text: From this one snapshot, simultaneously remove members whose preference is out and add admitted IDs outside W_before with p=in and c>=mu.
operations.new_text: From this one snapshot, simultaneously remove members whose preference is out and add admitted IDs outside W_before with p=in and gate_value[x]>=mu.

operations.old_text: Immutable FINAL-in members retain c=beta_c, so a nonempty frozen W has mean beta_c; a later gate entrant can have c=beta_c while its previous success side differs from p=in and is not FINAL. Such an entrant invalidates the freeze, and refreezing requires the existing freeze predicate to hold again.
operations.new_text: Immutable FINAL-in members retain c=beta_c and previous success side IN, so a nonempty frozen W has mean gate value beta_c. A later gate entrant must have previous success side IN, c=beta_c and p=in; it is therefore FINAL-in.

operations.old_text: Evaluation may sweep K as an experimental input without adding a production tuning parameter to this core contract.
operations.new_text:
Evaluation may sweep K as an experimental input without adding a production tuning parameter to this core contract.

Acceptance fixtures run to a horizon long enough to finish and report the freeze-round distribution, including any nonfinishing trials without hiding them through uncensored quantiles. There is no >=99%-within25-rounds acceptance condition. Hard assertions remain zero false freezes and zero split freezes. Retain the prescribed seeds and trial counts; performance distributions are reported, not replaced by a fixed25-round completion-rate target.

operations.old_text: IMPCD iteration 4 found and corrected F1–F4. F5 remains OPEN: P4 still requires >=99% of1000 fixed seeds to freeze within25 rounds, but a permitted RTT configuration of the silent/slow fixture has an independently calculated completion probability of about50.4% under the current quorum and consecutive-success rules. The target, seeds and protocol are unchanged; actual fixture outcomes have not been executed. This unresolved acceptance conflict requires an author decision before the contract can be called finished.
operations.new_text: F1 and F5 are CLOSED by the final operator resolutions in the maintained input bundle. The gate and its mean use c only for previous success IN, otherwise zero. The obsolete >=99%-within25-rounds acceptance condition is removed; fixtures run to a horizon long enough to finish and report freeze-round distributions, retaining zero false freezes and zero split freezes as hard assertions. No unresolved author decision remains from iteration4; independent review continues.

operations.old_text: | T13_gate_simultaneous_prechange_mean | §8 | W c values 0,10 and outside-IN c values 10,5 use mean 5 and admit both regardless of iteration order; include simultaneous exits, equality and empty-W mean zero |
operations.new_text: | T13_gate_simultaneous_prechange_mean | §8 | W gate values 0,10 and outside-IN gate values 10,5 use mean 5 and admit both regardless of iteration order; include simultaneous exits, equality and empty-W mean zero. Positive gate values require previous success IN; previous OUT or absent contributes zero even when c is positive, in both the W mean and entry comparison |

operations.old_text: | T13_later_gate_entry_invalidates_freeze | §8 | Frozen nonempty W has mean beta_c. Keep a live Pending x through 11 IN,1 OUT,11 IN,12 OUT successes: d[in]=22,d[out]=13,p=in,c=12,previous=out,not FINAL. Admit preserving state, then one OUT success gives d[out]=14 and admits x through the unchanged gate. The root changes and the old freeze is invalid; no refreeze while x is nonfinal. Also retain the later FINAL-in entry case |
operations.new_text: | T13_later_gate_entry_invalidates_freeze | §8 | Frozen nonempty W has mean gate value beta_c. A live Pending x after 11 IN,1 OUT,11 IN,12 OUT successes has d[in]=22,d[out]=13,p=in,c=12,previous=out,not FINAL. Admission preserves state; a further OUT success leaves its gate value zero and it cannot enter frozen W. Require twelve subsequent IN successes to become FINAL-in and pass the beta_c gate; entry changes the root and invalidates the old freeze. Also test previous-IN FINAL-in entry and zero contributions from previous-OUT members when computing the W mean |
